author: Pelpelajax
body:
Hello,

Since these changes seem to have gone by unnoticed, I thought I'd update you guys.

You can now invite teams using this;
/scrim invites
/scrim invite <team tag>
/scrim uninvite <team tag>

Other then this, NCP also got removed. Please thank KyloCode for these changes.
Have fun scrimming!
